描述

使用 Nvidia Cosmos 的图像到视频 ComfyUI 工作流程。它基于 ComfyUI 示例页面的默认工作流程。但经过一些修改。

https://comfyanonymous.github.io/ComfyUI_examples/cosmos/

zip 文件包含 json 文件、起始图像和带有工作流程的 png 文件。

方法论

将初始图像拖入图像节点，调整提示，然后按队列。其余的应该合适。

升级

请注意，升级应该在额外的步骤中进行。如果就算了。 Cosmos 生成的视频已经相当大了。最小尺寸为 704 x 704。您可以在我关于 comfyui 中视频升级的文章中找到示例升级工作流程：https://www.tomgoodnoise.de/index.php/video-upscaling-in-comfyui/

限制

如前所述，最小尺寸为 704 x 704 像素。

杂项

除了重要节点之外，还有一些折叠的注释节点。单击它们以展开它们。

注释节点包含更多信息。如果是模型，还可以链接到模型以及将它们放在哪里。

时间

示例视频的渲染速度非常慢，需要 52 分钟，再加上一些准备开销。 Cosmos 视频生成速度很慢。作为比较，Cogvideo 在 8 或 4 分钟内完成了类似的工作。 LTXVideo 一分为二。

要求

此工作流程是使用 16 GB vram 生成的。最低要求是 12 GB vram。并且您的系统 RAM 不应少于 32 GB。

o.en:
Description

An image to video ComfyUI workflow with Nvidia Cosmos. It is based at the default workflow from the ComfyUI example page. But with some modifications.

https://comfyanonymous.github.io/ComfyUI_examples/cosmos/

The zipfile contains the json file, the starter image, and a png file with the workflow.

Howto

Drag an initial image into the image node, adjust the prompt, and press queue. The rest should fit.

Upscaling

Note that upscaling should happen in an extra step. If even. Cosmos generates already pretty big videos. With a minimum size of 704 x 704. You can find example upscaling workflows in my article about video upscaling in comfyui:https://www.tomgoodnoise.de/index.php/video-upscaling-in-comfyui/

Limits

The minimum size is 704 x 704 pixels, as mentioned.

Misc

There are some collapsed Note nodes besides the important nodes. Click at them to expand them.

The Note nodes contain further informations. And in case of the models also links to the models, and where to put them.

Time

The example video rendered in very slow 52 minutes plus some overhead for preparation. Cosmos video generaton is slow. As a comparison, Cogvideo does a similar job in 8 or 4 minutes. LTXVideo in two.

Requirements

This workflow was generated with 16 gb vram. Minimum requirement is 12 gb vram. And you should not have fewer than 32 gb system ram.
